comments.author: sgrytoyr
comments.story: On El Capitan’s Dawn Wall, Climb Thought to Be Toughest Progresses Slowly
comments.why: Frightening free solo of El Sendero Luminoso by Alex Honnold.
comments.text: Fantastic achievement if they pull it off. Incidentally, Alex Honnold, one of the climbers interviewed in the article, is the star of one of the most frightening videos I have ever seen - him free-soloing El Sendero Luminoso: [VIDEO] Even though I know perfectly well that nobody fell to their death on that climb, and have done a fair bit of climbing myself, I can’t watch this video without having a powerful physical reaction. It’s mind-boggling what some people are capable of.

comments.author: Fricken
comments.story: Rock climber Alex Honnold doesn’t experience fear like the rest of us
comments.text: Here's a video that touches on Honnold's prep for his ascent of El Sendoro Luminoso. Given that it's likely the most difficult ropeless climb in history (and on limestone, which is far more prone to breaking holds than Yosemite granite), he wasn't exactly super meticulous: [VIDEO] At lower grades he has been known to just go for it.
